Presets describe typical usage only. Current capabilities and required host ports
select live offering; actual role, extent, consent and write coverage remain server
decisions. Pure content helpers may be used offline. Hosted user hosts omit Node,
publisher reads and publisher export ports. This table describes contract policy;
versioned live evidence is linked from the implementing change.

Local-only operations outside the registry: dev save/restore/start/stop, config
mutation, publish/reset and module deployment. Hosted MCP offers no such lifecycle
contract. Full-world export requires the local publisher port; scoped grant export
is governed by its binding-specific policy and returns TOML without host files.

Payload mode is documented in [shared authoring input](../README.md). Client tool
lists can be cached: request tools/list again or reconnect after a grant. Every
execution rechecks current authority, so a cached revoked tool cannot grant access.
No universal push tool-list refresh is promised. Presence-only sessions have no
physical character movement; actor selection never creates a character claim.
